$schema.description: JSON Schema URL for editor support; ignored by Force Org

terms.description: the game's own words for built-in concepts, in expressions and the UI

grants.description: contingent resources a filled slot of this role grants its contingent, e.g. `{ "reserve": 1, "elite": 1 }`; a slot with several roles grants as the first that grants anything

additionalProperties.description: A unit type; `description` holds the rules every unit of the type follows

subTypes.description: unit sub-types (validator 1.12.0); when set, unit and profile `tags`, `tag:` references and profile filter values that match no sub-type (or unit type) are warnings

optionLabel.description: what the slot options offered on slots with this tag are called, e.g. "Special Option"; left out, "Option"

color.description: the tag's colour in the app's palette (`amber`, `red`, `orange`, `green`, `teal`, `blue`, `violet`, `pink`, `slate`); left out or unknown, the app picks one from the tag's id

icon.description: the tag's mark in the app's icon set (`star`, `spark`, `diamond`, `hex`, `cross`, `flag`, `swords`, `crown`, `fleur`, `circle`, `triangle`, `square`, `target`, `bolt`); left out or unknown, the app picks one from the tag's id

scope.description: `list`: spent across the list against a limit the player sets (points, credits). `unit`: spent within one unit against a capacity from its profile (equipment slots). `contingent`: granted and spent within each contingent, never set by the player (reserve points); going below zero is a list issue

message.description: contingent resources: the issue shown when a contingent has spent too much

usedFor.description: what amounts in this resource may be given for; left out, by scope: `list` → unit, additional model, option, slot option and group costs; `unit` → option and slot option costs; `contingent` → group costs and grants

defaultLimit.description: list resources: the limit offered for new lists

capacityStat.description: unit resources: the profile stat holding the unit's capacity

choices.description: list-level choices, e.g. stance or battle size

listRules.description: typed list-wide rules, e.g. percentage caps

groups.description: groups every faction may take (core formations shared by every faction)

specialRules.description: special rules that belong to no single faction

slotOptions.description: choices slots with a tag offer (e.g. benefits for tagged slots)

subChoices.description: sub-choices options in every faction may offer

__schema3.description: A record id: lowercase kebab-case, e.g. `infantry-squad` (letters a-z and digits, with single hyphens between words)

word.description: For built-in scopes (and `group` as a reference kind): the word data authors may write in expressions instead of the built-in name, e.g. `formation` for `group`

__schema7.description: A plain number, or an expression that evaluates to one

__schema9.description: An expression in the Force Org expression language (docs/specs/expression_language_spec_2026-10-17.md)

additionalProperties.description: A unit sub-type, given to units and profiles as a `tags` entry matching its name (case-insensitively) or id; `description` holds the rules every model with the sub-type follows

contingent.description: `root` groups start a contingent; linked groups attach to a root group of one of the listed types and share its faction source

source.description: root groups only: `main` uses the list's main faction and sub-faction, `ally` a different one the player picks. Left out = `main`

min.description: how many of this type a list may hold (at least)

max.description: how many of this type a list may hold (at most)

cost.description: what a group of this type costs, counted in its contingent for contingent resources and in the list for list resources, e.g. `{ "reserve": 1, "elite": 1 }`; a group's own `cost` replaces it

items.description: Where an amount in a resource can be given: a unit's cost, the cost of each additional model, an option's cost (with its sub-choice values), a slot option's cost, a group's cost, or what a role or special rule grants

numeric.description: numeric stats can be shifted by stat effects ('3+' -1 → '2+')

additionalProperties.description: A list-level choice, e.g. stance or battle size
One of a list choice's values

__schema24.description: the units `effects` apply to, seen with their own traits and sub-faction modifiers (validator 1.13.0); left out = every unit in the list, allies included

anyOf.description: A named selector by id, accepted wherever a `UnitSelector` is, e.g. `"@line-infantry"`

__schema26.description: Picks units by id, role, trait and profile type/tags; left out, a field matches every unit

__schema29.description: a unit matches when it has any of these traits, matched as case-insensitive text

__schema31.description: a unit matches when one of its profiles does (or the unit itself, if it has no profiles)

__schema32.description: Picks profiles by their type and tags (the unit's included), matched as case-insensitive text. Left out, every profile is picked.

__schema35.description: a unit that matches any of these does not match the selector

items.description: Units to leave out, matched like a selector (its fields all apply); e.g. `{ "profiles": { "anyOf": ["Unique"] } }` leaves out every unit with a Unique profile

__schema37.description: stat, special-rule and trait effects on every matching unit in the list while this value is picked (validator 1.13.0), e.g. a stance value giving every unit a trait

items.description: applied to every matching unit in the list while the value is picked, right after the unit's own traits and sub-faction modifiers; the pick is already the condition, so a `when` needs no `choice()`

__schema39.description: several stat changes sharing one profile filter

items.description: `add` shifts the number and keeps its suffix: '3+' -1 → '2+', '6"' +1 → '7"'

__schema46.description: A rule's condition plus the player-facing reason shown when it isn't met

__schema49.description: changes the unit's traits (traits belong to the whole unit, so there is no profile filter); traits match as case-insensitive text

__schema53.description: traits the unit loses, if it has them

__schema55.description: the unit loses any of `from` and, only if it had one, gains `to`

oneOf.description: Caps what may be spent on matching units, e.g. heavy units 25%, allies 50%
Limits how many matching units (or groups) a scope may hold
Escape hatch for list rules no typed form covers. A rule only flags the list; it never prevents anything

__schema61.description: count only these units; left out = every unit

__schema62.description: count only units in contingents whose root group is one of these types

__schema74.description: `list` (default): the condition is checked once for the whole list. `group`: checked once for each group (of the listed `groupTypes`, or any) with `group`, `contingent`, `root`, `main` and `list` available; the message is reported for each group that fails

__schema76.description: with `scope: "group"`: only groups of these types

type.description: a group type id from the game

roles.description: units of any of these roles may fill the slot

required.description: must be filled for the list to be valid (compulsory slots)

repeat.description: the slot may be added more than once, each copy holding one unit (a team's vehicles, optional slots); `max` left out = no limit

units.description: only matching units may fill this slot; with a `source`, `unitIds` are the source's units
only matching units may fill any slot, including slots a mechanic adds, except slots with a `source`

requirementText.description: shown when a requirement isn't met

min.description: how many of this group a list must hold, e.g. a mandatory veteran formation

max.description: how many of this group a list may hold

effects.description: applied to every unit in the group, e.g. "Every unit in this group gains the Gun Line trait"

__schema82.description: Where a slot's units come from instead of the contingent. Units keep their own records (gear, rules, upgrades) but not their home sub-faction's unit modifiers. The slot's `units` selector picks among them, seeing only each unit's own traits; the group's `units` doesn't apply

__schema83.description: a faction of the same game, possibly from another source; may be the contingent's own

__schema84.description: units of these sub-factions of `faction` may fill the slot too (`any` = every one loaded), whether or not the contingent took them; left out, only the faction's own units

__schema86.description: applied to the unit filling the slot, after the group's effects, e.g. replacing a borrowed unit's faction trait

items.description: units the list must already hold before the group can be taken

__schema90.description: where they're counted: the group's contingent outside it (default) or its root group

items.description: applied to every unit in the group, including units in slots added later

configurable.description: the rule takes a value, e.g. Ambush (X)

defaultValue.description: the value a configurable rule has when a selection gives none

grants.description: contingent resources a unit with the rule grants its contingent (negative takes some away). Expressions may use the `rule` scope, e.g. Quartermaster (X) `{ "reserve": "rule.value() - 1" }`

slots.description: slots each unit with the rule adds to its group, e.g. one filled from another faction

items.description: A slot a mechanic adds to a group

__schema98.description: the slot's role; with several the player picks one

__schema99.description: only matching units may fill the slot; with a `source`, `unitIds` are the source's units

additionalProperties.description: A selector with a name, referenced as `@id` from expressions and selector fields
A choice made for a slot with the option's tag, applying its effects to the unit in the slot (and the group), e.g. special benefits or enhancements. One option per tag per slot.

__schema105.description: offered on slots with this tag

__schema106.description: only offered on slots of these roles; left out = any role

__schema108.description: only offered on slots whose unit matches, seen as it stands before slot-option effects (its traits from option and group effects included), e.g. `{ "traits": ["Field Army"] }` for an option only Field Army units may take; left out = any unit

__schema109.description: added to the cost of the unit in the slot

oneOf.description: adds a slot to the group; with several roles the player picks one
units of these roles may also fill the slot

additionalProperties.description: A choice made alongside an option, defined once and shared by every option that offers it

costMultiplier.description: resource id → multiplier for the option's cost, e.g. a turret mount `{ "points": 3 }`
